findings.text: The company was incorporated on 10 February 2004 and has 2 current directors: PERSON 320 (appointed 1 May 2006) and PERSON 321 (appointed 10 February 2004).
One insolvency case is on record, in administration, with administration started on 12 December 2025.
Accounts are overdue; the next accounts were due 30 December 2025, and the last accounts were made up to 30 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is overdue; the next statement is due 5 June 2026, and the last was made up to 22 May 2025.

Two current persons with significant control are recorded: PERSON 326 (individual; ownership of shares 25 to 50 percent, voting rights 25 to 50 percent, right to appoint and remove directors) and PERSON 327 (individual; significant influence or control).
The current directors have other appointments, including one administration case across the 2 directors' linked companies: 11 other companies were found, of which 1 is in administration.
One registered office address change was filed on 29 December 2025 since 24 October 2025, and no officer appointments or resignations were filed in that period.
